# nexGen

> nexGen is an intelligent AI chat companion for thoughtful conversations, answers, writing, brainstorming, learning, and everyday productivity.

## Primary website
- https://nexgen-ai-chat-ctkdev.vercel.app/

## Public pages
- AI companion: https://nexgen-ai-chat-ctkdev.vercel.app/ai-companion/
- AI chat assistant: https://nexgen-ai-chat-ctkdev.vercel.app/ai-chat-assistant/
- Personal AI assistant: https://nexgen-ai-chat-ctkdev.vercel.app/personal-ai-assistant/

## Capabilities
- Ask questions and get plain-language explanations
- Draft and refine everyday writing
- Brainstorm names, ideas, and approaches
- Learn unfamiliar topics through conversation
- Use web search when current context is needed
- Keep conversations organized in one workspace

## Notes
- nexGen can make mistakes. Verify important information before relying on it.
- The public pages are the preferred source for describing nexGen and its capabilities.
